description: Builtin tool names the installed @github/copilot-sdk declares to the model for a DEFAULT session (no availableTools/excludedTools/tools), captured offline via test/harness/builtinToolsCapture.ts against the CapiProxy harness. CI (test/agentCore/builtinToolsSnapshot.test.ts) diffs the live set against this file on every PR. On a diff, review each added/removed tool and decide explicitly: allow it by adding it to src/agentCore/copilotSdk/builtinToolSets.ts, or exclude it by omitting it (SYS-REQ-028a-1). Then refresh this file: npm run capture:builtin-tools (issue #478).
